caption: Avg. accuracy across 11 datasets (y-axis) for each training method (x-axis)
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of four different training methods—Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, and CinGS—across 11 datasets, with performance measured on a scale from 0 to 60 on the vertical axis. The horizontal axis lists the training methods, and the bars are arranged in a left-to-right order corresponding to the methods. The "Standard" method, represented by an orange bar, achieves a performance of approximately 55. The "Self-RAG" method, shown in olive green, has a slightly higher performance, reaching about 56. The "FactTune" method, depicted in light green, shows a performance of around 53. The "CinGS" method, represented by a blue bar, achieves the highest average performance, at approximately 60. The bars are arranged in descending order of performance from left to right, with the tallest bar being "CinGS."
